mainText: Die wichtigsten KI-Meldungen: Hochfrequenzhändler investieren Milliarden in KI-Rechenleistung. Hochfrequenzhändler wie Jane Street und Hudson River Trading liefern sich inzwischen einen Wettlauf um Rechenleistung für KI. (The Decoder.) Grok releases the first seven minutes of its AI-generated ‘Odyssey’. The footage looks okay, as long as you're not seeking artistry, inspiration, or human interest. (TechCrunch AI.) Toyota will mit 400.000 Robotern und Milliarden-Investment zum Robotik-Riesen werden. Toyota will zum globalen Robotik-Konzern werden und investiert dafür in humanoide Roboter und Fabrikautomatisierung. (The Decoder.) AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says. "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America … (TechCrunch AI.) Nvidias offene Daten-Engine Flora soll Robotikdaten 125-mal günstiger beschriften als GPT-6 Astra. Nvidias neue Daten-Engine Flora soll eine Stunde Robotervideo für 72 Cent annotieren statt für 88 Dollar mit GPT-6 Astra, bei leicht besserer Qualität. (The Decoder.)

Aus der Tech-Welt: The best apps for tracking your reading and discovering new books. There are numerous apps on the market that promise to do just that, so we’ve compiled a list of some of the best ones to help you pick the right one for you. (TechCrunch.) ‘Cyberselfish’ author takes aim at techno-libertarianism as her book returns from the dead. "That's a 12-year-old view of the world." (TechCrunch.) TechCrunch Mobility: Blue-green is the color of autonomy. Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it. (TechCrunch.) The hottest AI wearables and gadgets you should know about. We compiled a list of all the hottest AI wearables, including Muse Charm, Bee, Friend, Plaud, and more. (TechCrunch.)

Neues aus der Szene: Mathame launch new label, NEO Records, share single: Listen. The Italian duo described the imprint as “a place for new talent to grow, for ideas to take shape, and for a community to come together through music” (DJ Mag.) New music on our radar this week: Blackhaine, Nabihah Iqbal, DNGDNGDNG. All the biggest releases on our radar (Mixmag.) SBTV announces full line-up for 20th anniversary show at The O2 honouring Jamal Edwards. Performers will include Devlin, Krept & Konan, Chip, Lady Leshurr, Tinie Tempah, Wiley, and more (DJ Mag.) Festival line-ups you might have missed: GALA, Pitch Arts & Music, Westival. Rounding up festival news from across the dance and electronic world (Mixmag.)
